description: This file defines a class 'PdfDiagnostics' within the PdfSharp.Pdf.Internal namespace. The class provides static properties for toggling debug or tracing options related to PDF processing, specifically for compressed objects, xref streams, and object streams.

classes.name: PdfDiagnostics
classes.description: Provides static properties to enable or disable various tracing options during PDF processing, such as tracing compressed objects or stream information.

methods.name: TraceCompressedObjects
methods.description: Gets or sets a boolean indicating whether the compression objects should be traced during debugging.

methods.name: TraceXrefStreams
methods.description: Gets or sets a boolean indicating whether xref streams should be traced, dependent on TraceCompressedObjects.

methods.name: TraceObjectStreams
methods.description: Gets or sets a boolean indicating whether object streams should be traced, dependent on TraceCompressedObjects.
